name: Basic Rod
description: Wood and vine lashed into a simple fishing rod.
effect: Opens the Fishing Pond. 12 durability; repair in the workshop.

name: Stone Knife
description: A sharp flake of stone bound to a wooden grip.
effect: Cut herbs and roots while foraging.

name: Stone Axe
description: A heavy stone head wedged into a split branch.
effect: Chop fallen trees for extra wood.

name: Stone Spear
description: A stone point lashed to a long, straight shaft.
effect: Holds predators at a distance. Opens fights you can win.

name: Torch
description: Resin-soaked fiber wrapped around a stick.
effect: New choices when the night turns dark.

name: Machete
description: A broad salvage-steel blade with a hardwood grip.
effect: Opens the dense trail to the Ancient Ruins.

name: Leaf Bed
description: Layers of broad leaves on a low wooden frame.
effect: Sleep restores +6 health and +4 sanity.

name: Water Filter
description: Sand, charcoal and stone layered in a bark funnel.
effect: +6 water whenever you collect water.

name: Rain Collector
description: A broad leaf funnel draining into a hollow log.
effect: +5 water every dawn, +12 more after rain.

name: Drying Rack
description: Smoke and dry your catch above the fire.
effect: Each fish eaten restores +10 more food.

name: Emergency Beacon
description: A rescued radio powered by the old survey core.
effect: Send a signal, then keep it alive through the final rescue storm.

name: Basic Refuge
description: A sturdier shelter, storage crates and a simple workbench.
effect: Sleep restores +4 health and +4 sanity. Unlocks the Rain Collector, the Drying Rack and the road to the Plane Wreck.

name: Established Camp
description: A raised platform, water barrel, drying rack and cooking station.
effect: +6 water every dawn and better recovery. Opens the way to the Ancient Ruins.

name: Rescue Base
description: An advanced workbench, a radio corner and a proper bed.
effect: The best recovery in the jungle. Unlocks beacon assembly.

name: Charcoal
description: Slow-burn wood into clean charcoal.
effect: Makes 2 portions for antidotes.

name: Antidote
description: Prepare a charcoal and herb remedy.
effect: Clears poison; does not restore lost health.

name: Bandage
description: Wrap clean plant fibres around a herbal dressing.
effect: Treats injury, then restores a little health.

name: Leaf Rain Cape
description: Layer broad leaves over a fibre frame.
effect: Reduces rain exposure; does not protect against wading.

name: Reinforced Rod
description: Bamboo sections reinforced with tightly bound line.
effect: Wider reeling zone; lands catfish and spiny fish. 20 durability.

name: River Rod
description: A hardwood rod with a salvaged reel and strong line.
effect: Best control; can land rare Goldspot Riverfish. 30 durability.

name: Insect Bait
description: Bundle grasshoppers collected from broad leaves.
effect: Makes 2 portions. Favours surface-hunting fish.

name: Fruit Bait
description: Cut a portion of ember berries into small bait pieces.
effect: Makes 3 portions. Attracts unusual river fish.

name: Reinforced Axe
description: A reinforced field tool built for longer journeys.
effect: 16 durability. GOOD zone ×1.10; +1 wood per successful chopping attempt.

name: Salvage Axe
description: A reinforced field tool built for longer journeys.
effect: 24 durability. GOOD zone ×1.20; +2 wood per successful attempt; extra hardwood with two perfect strikes.

name: Hunting Spear
description: A balanced spear with a stronger shaft and a carefully shaped point.
effect: 16 durability. Hunting GOOD zone ×1.10; +8 percentage points on risky spear decisions.

name: Salvage Spear
description: A balanced spear with a stronger shaft and a carefully shaped point.
effect: 24 durability. Hunting GOOD zone ×1.20; +15 percentage points on risky spear decisions.

name: Trail Backpack
description: Reinforced plant-fiber straps and hardwood supports.
effect: Backpack capacity grows from 8 to 12 slots. Equipped gear uses separate slots.

name: Expedition Pack
description: A durable expedition pack built around a salvaged frame.
effect: Backpack capacity grows from 12 to 16 slots. Permanent for this run; does not wear out.
